title: Blockhithelper
description: This mod is made to help improving at block hit in minecraft 1.8.9 pvp
body: Blockhit Trainer is a lightweight practice mod designed to help players improve their blockhitting timing. When you successfully time a blockhit that reduces incoming damage, the mod plays a satisfying ding sound to provide instant feedback. Build muscle memory, improve consistency, and master one of the most important PvP mechanics.
